tabs.tab1_description:
10 Mukhi Nepalese Rudraksha radiates abundant ecstatic energy capable to mitigate any negative circumstance by elevating our emotions and provides relief from miseries, misfortunes, negativity, debts and losses.  It also provides protection from evil eyes and black magic. It blesses the wearer with harmonious relationships, creativity, happiness and contentment. This rudraksha unblocks and brings to balance the sacral or Swadhisthana chakra which is our emotional hub. Thus, it makes life joyful by dispelling fears and enhancing creativity. The 10 mukhi rudraksha holds the energy of the Ten directions and symbolizes Lord Krishna, the 8th Avatar of Lord Narayana. Hence, this divine Rudraksha is believed to be a powerful protection shield that safeguards the wearer. The original 10 mukhi rudraksha possesses the divine powers of Lord Krishna and brings the wearer happiness, peace, love, and passion. It bestows harmonious relationships, creativity, enjoyment, and contentment upon the wearer. It increases connection with Lord Krishna which allows one to focus on spiritual practices without interference from evil forces and feeling protected from all kind of problems. The 10 mukhi Rudraksha is one of the most wonderful Rudraksha beads available in Nature. In every Yuga, Lord Vishnu is known to take ten Avatars after the Pralaya. Thus, the 10 Nepal Mukhi Rudraksha represents the ten Avatars of Lord Vishnu. According to Rudraksha Jabalo Upanishad the ten mukhi Rudraksha bead is blessed by Lord of Death, Lord Yama and the guardians of the 10 different directions (10 Dikpalas) so it acts as a protective shield in all 10 directions. Apart from safeguarding the wearer, the 10 mukhi rudraksha uplifts the quality of personal and professional life. This is a rudraksha of joyful relationships.

According to Srimad Bhagavatam 11th Skand Chapter 4, Lord Narayana said:

Ten Mukhi Rudraksha is Vishnu and removes all the tears and troubles due from planets, evil powers and snakes. The ten mukhi rudraksha thus offers a bundle of therapeutic benefits and boons to the wearer.

 

Scriptural Reference of 10 mukhi Rudraksha

Shiva Purana. Chapter 25, Sloka 76.

Dashavaktro maheshani svayam devo janardanah |
Dharanattasya deveshi sarvankamanavapnuyat || 76 ||
Hey Maheshwari, the ten faced Rudraksha is the form of Lord Janardan himself. It completes all works.

Padma Purana, Chapter 59, Verse 183b:

दशवक्त्रं धारयन् नरः सर्पाः क्षयं यान्ति तस्य वै।

Translation: By wearing a ten-mouthed Rudraksha, serpents (all forms of poison and negative influences) are destroyed for that person.

Devi Bhagavata Purana, Skandha 11, Adhyaya 3, summary:

दशमुखं जनार्दनः पिशाचभूतवेतालराक्षसपन्नगशान्तिदः।

Translation: The ten-faced Rudraksha is Janardana (Vishnu). Wearing it pacifies the effects of ghosts, spirits, evil entities, and poisonous serpents or reptiles (pannaga).

10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha is available in a variety of sizes, including: small, regular, large and collector. The bigger the size of the rudraksha the faster the results. This is because the seeds are bigger and the surface area in contact with skin is larger, thus, energy is dispersed more quickly throughout the body.

10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha Price

Rudra Centre offers 10 mukhi Rudraksha from Nepal of the highest quality at a very affordable price. Since it is an agricultural product the harvest of any season determines the price and this can vary from season to season. Rudra Centre sources all our Rudraksha directly from farmers in Nepal, our beads undergo a strict selection process where the size, health, weight and many other relevant parameters of the rudraksha are analysed, since we are the biggest suppliers of Nepal Rudraksha in the world, we are able to provide the best quality Rudraksha at the most reasonable prices to our customers.

As per our research bigger sized beads work faster. Bigger sized beads are rarer, so they are higher priced than smaller sized beads. As per the size of the bead, the Nepalese 10 mukhi rudraksha is classified into small, regular, large & collector.

The price of 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha ranges between INR 5,800 – INR 14,000 (USD 72.50 – USD 175) depending on their size. There may be some unique well-formed big sized 10 mukhi Nepalese Rudraksha beads which come under the Super Collector variety which are priced as per their rarity.

What differentiates Nepal and Java 10 mukhi Rudrakshas?

The internal structure of the Nepal and Java varieties of 10 mukhi rudraksha is identical, so their properties are equal. Recurrent experiments and client feedback indicate that the only difference is the size of the beads. Nepal variety beads are larger and better formed than Java variety beads; consequently, they work faster because the surface area is more developed and hence the intensity of the healing frequency is more protracted. However, the long-term effects of both varieties are nearly identical. Because Nepal beads are rarer than Java beads, the 10 mukhi from Nepal is more expensive than 10 mukhi from Java. However, many people prefer Java beads because they are smaller and can be worn as alluring jewellery. It is up to the individual to decide.

The 10 mukhi rudraksha possesses the divine powers of Lord Krishna and, as a result, saves and protects those whose path is blocked by obstacles and all sorts of problems. Everyone who is feeling low should wear this rudraksha, as it quickly improves one's mood. Those who struggle in romantic relationships will also find harmony when they wear it. This rudraksha elevates the wearer above mundane problems, surrounding him with a blend of charisma and calmness, hence, whenever things become turbulent, this rudraksha is very calming. This rudraksha of happiness and harmony naturally repels anything that is not of the same nature, so its naturally relieving for doomed people. Those who suffer from anger issues or those under the spell of black magic also benefit from wearing 10 mukhi Nepal rudraksha. It is vvery propitious for creative professionals in any field; and last but not least, this rudraksha is especially advantageous for Lord Krishna's devotees as it strengthens their bond with Him.

How to wear 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

The stringing of 10 mukhi beads in Kantha Mala or Bracelet is very important so that the circuit of energy flow is maintained. Rudra Centre strings multiple beads of 10 mukhi as per our patented Rudraksha Ratna Chakra Therapy (RRCT) which taps into 100% potential of 10 mukhi beads.

Before shipping it to you, Rudra Centre will energise your 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha so that it can be worn immediately, nevertheless; Thursdays are also ideal for wearing or beginning to wear a 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha.

How long does it take for 10 mukhi Nepal to Start working?

If worn according to RRCT, the 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha will resonate with your body within three to four days. You will notice that your emotional and mental processes become more streamlined, and you will feel considerably more at ease. Depending on the individual, you will see quantifiable results after a few weeks or months of use as your Vishuddha chakra become balanced.

How to energize the 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Rudra Centre performs the Pran Prathistha energizing procedure of your 10 mukhi Nepalese rudraksha before shipping it to you, so you already receive it energized.

If you do not wear your 10 mukhi rudraksha bead for more than 2 weeks it will go into “sleep mode”. After this point you can wear it again and it will take 2 weeks to activate and another 2 or 3 days to get into resonance with your body.

If you wear 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha 24/7 as per RRCT you do not need to re-energize it again, which means to wear it while sleeping too. Only after long periods of not wearing the bead after receiving it from us, a re-energizing procedure would be needed. In this case, you can perform regular energization or Pran Prathistha of rudraksha by yourself, or you can also visit a local temple and get it energized from a priest. The detailed procedure of Rudraksha Puja Vidhi is described HERE

Rules to Wear 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha

Ensure that the rudraksha beads you are wearing are healthy and are not infested with insects or molds.

Ensure the Rudraksha you are wearing doesn’t have any cracks, the energy of the rudraksha is in its seeds. While external surface fractures are acceptable (but should be avoided), no fissures should reach the seeds, which must be intact.

In the case you shake a rudraksha bead and you can hear the seeds rattling, that means the rudraksha bead is lifeless.

Anyone regardless of their gender, caste, religion or age can wear Rudraksha, women can wear rudraksha during their menstrual cycle as well.

If you have not worn the Rudraksha in a long time you can follow the steps mentioned above, reenergize, and wear it.

There are no dietary restrictions associated with wearing Rudraksha, such as abstaining from meat or alcohol. Naturally, after a long period of wearing Rudraksha, our body adapts to a more sattvic diet in harmony with Rudraksha vibrations. The full potential of 10 mukhi rudraksha beads can be realized at that time or earlier if a sattvic diet is followed, though this is not compulsory to follow.

You can wear Rudraksha in toilet or washroom, but it is advisable to be cautious about soaps and shower gels adhering to the beads. If this occurs then rinse them with water as soon as possible. However, it is recommended to briefly remove the Rudraksha combination so that soap or other chemicals do not become trapped in the Rudraksha's grooves.

Rudraksha darkens overtime with usage as it absorbs oils, heat, sweat and dirt from the environment. It will turn from sandy brown to dark brown. If proper care is taken it will last for generations to come.
tabs.tab4_description:
How to identify original 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Some fraudulent tests have gained popularity and must be avoided because their results are unreliable and they cannot be used to determine the authenticity of Rudraksha.

The Fake tests are the Water Test, Milk test or Copper Coin Rotation Test. All these tests are unscientific and produce untrustworthy results.

One way to determine the originality of Rudraksha beads is to take an X-ray. In an X-ray, the compartment and seeds inside the Rudraksha are observable, and their number should ideally correspond to the number of Mukhi lines on the bead. Sometimes all seeds are not visible as they get compressed during formation and compartments are very close to each other, though.

Experts at Rudra Centre can examine the bead and determine if they are original or not. You can send us images and videos of your Rudraksha at the email: contact@rudracentre.com for our experts to determine authenticity.

In recent years many labs have emerged which offer Rudraksha certification however these are highly unreliable because they do not have the right knowledge and many times make mistakes in identifying Rudraksha beads. Many traders are using these labs to issue fake certificates. These labs are not able to distinguish manipulated beads where extra lines are carved on the Rudraksha to make it a higher mukhi which costs more. Also, they do not reject beads with incomplete mukhi lines which actually don’t give results. These labs are not affiliated with any central body or government, so they do not have any credibility. Hence to protect consumers Rudra Centre has opened its own laboratory and have started issuing genuine certificate where all parameters of the Rudraksha are analyzed. We examine whether the beads are healthy, whether the mukhi lines are complete, and whether the rudraksha beads has been manipulated.

At Rudra Centre, we issue certificates for all beads procured from us. If you want an X-ray certificate for the Rudraksha bead, then an additional INR 500 is charged per Rudraksha bead.

How to Clean & Maintain 10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha?

Rudraksha beads can last a lifetime and be passed down through generations if cared for properly.

In cold and dry climates, rudraksha beads may develop surface-level cracks, in which case any natural unscented oil may be applied, such as olive oil, sandal oil, or cow ghee.

Rudraksha may develop molds and insects if they are kept in a humid place and unused for a long time, in this case follow the below steps:

  • Dip the Rudraksha beads in lukewarm water for 15 mins.
  • Clean any molds visible of the surface using a toothbrush.
  • Dry them under the shade of the Sun (indirect Sunlight) or you can also use a dryer or hairdryer.
  • After following the above steps, you can start wearing your rudraksha beads or combination again.

Follow the steps below to regularly clean your Rudraksha beads:

  • Wash Rudraksha beads under running water.
  • Scrub the surface of the rudraksha to remove any dust particles caught in the grooves, using a toothbrush.
  • Use the shade of the Sun (indirect sunlight) or a hairdryer to dry the beads.
  • Apply any natural and unscented oil like Olive oil, Almond oil or Sandal oil.
  • If you are planning to not wear beads for a long duration, it is advisable to keep them in the fridge.
  • Do not use any chemical cleaner or insecticide or pesticide to clean or treat your Rudraksha.
  • Do not put your rudraksha beads in boiling water or extremely hot water.

10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha Health & Color

10 mukhi Nepal Rudraksha will become darker overtime with usage because it is exposed to oil, sweat and the environment, this is a natural process and doesn’t affect the energy of the Rudraksha bead. It is best to choose a light Sandy Brown to Brown color Rudraksha bead as it generally means the bead is healthy and freshly (recently) harvested. It is advised to avoid wearing dark black or dark grey color beads as they may be lifeless. To check if the bead is healthy and alive just shake the bead well and if you hear the seeds inside rattling then it means that the bead is lifeless or dead and if there is no rattling sound then the bead is healthy and alive. You can inspect the bead from all sides and look inside the natural hole to ensure that there are no white color molds or insects which have infested the bead. Sometimes the soap gets stuck in the grooves, which are white in color; therefore, you should determine whether the white deposits are soap or mold. The mold will appear as threads whereas the soap deposits will be like a cream or paste. The energy of the Rudraksha beads resides is in its seeds, thus we must ensure that the seeds are healthy and alive.
